verdict.rationale: Skills live as per-skill SKILL.md files in a shared `skills/` source of truth (docs-13, docs-15, docs-17). The using-superpowers skill sets activation rules, telling the agent to invoke relevant skills before any action, with example routing such as "Fix this bug" → systematic-debugging (docs-16, docs-77) and a stated precedence order (docs-32). A skills-search tool aids discovery (docs-20), and the plugin page summarizes what the main skills do (docs-50, docs-61, docs-62). However, skills auto-trigger with no user action (gh-11), and nothing shows that every skill declares its own trigger conditions. Missing for 10: evidence that each individual skill documents its activation conditions (e.g. per-skill description or trigger metadata), a complete catalog of skills with their triggers, and independent corroboration that activation is predictable in practice.
